description: This file defines the NodeInterface interface for a nested set hierarchy within the ORM component of the OrangeHRM project. It specifies methods related to tree structure interactions such as retrieving children or parent nodes, inserting nodes, and checking node properties.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if the node has any children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves the child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Checks if the node has a parent.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node if it exists.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level (depth) of the node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts this node as the last child of a specified parent node.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf node (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root of the hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes this node and its descendants.
